text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate detected in inference-gateway (prefix-kv layer) - 15% error rate over 5m. Paging on-call for infra:sre.

morgan: seeing a bunch of gateway 502/504s, starts ~10:04 UTC. traces show kv lookups failing with connection reset and timeouts. Could be eviction storm.

anya: confirming — dashboards show prefix-kv miss rate spike and backend origin error count rising. latency also increased for 99p.

devon: I can jump on debug, oncall for infra today. grabbing logs.

sre_chris: quick customer impact note: two customers reported internal 5xx for generation endpoints, looks like some requests are failing fast. Not widespread but visible for medium-sized requests (seq len >1024).

morgan: stack traces include "kv: entry not found" followed by rapid rehydration attempts. There's also a flurry of eviction churn on shard-7.

anya: running query on metrics: prefix_kv_evictions{shard="7"} spiked x40 at 10:03. Prefetch queue backed up.

devon: repeating log excerpt: ```
ERROR kv_client shard=7 err=connection reset by peer
WARN cache manager: eviction triggered for prefix=usr:ctx:*, candidate_count=12000
INFO prefetcher: aborting 32 inflight fetches due to backlog
```

eng_lead_tara: initial mitigation ideas: 1) throttle prefetchers and pause aggressive prewarming 2) increase in-memory cache TTL for hot prefixes 3) route traffic off shard-7 to healthy shards via routing policy. Which is fastest?

sre_chris: fastest is to flip routing policy to avoid shard-7 (soft bypass) — we can do that from console, 60s to roll. Also reduce prefetch parallelism via config rollout.

devon: I'll flip soft bypass now and reduce prefetch concurrency from 64 -> 8. Doing a canary to 10% then 50%.

pager: @devon please add a short blurb in the handoff that you did routing bypass and prefetch throttle.

morgan: applied bypass at 10:10 UTC -> error rate dropped to ~6% in 2m. Increasing to 50% now.

support_julia: Customer comms: queued a note to affected customers indicating degraded reliability on generation endpoints, investig to follow. No credit/legal asks yet.

devon: increased bypass to 50% at 10:12 UTC -> 5xx down to 2.5%, latency improving. Prefetch throttle rollout at 10:14 UTC check.

anya: after throttle, prefetch backlog decreased, evictions on shard-7 reduced by 90% in metrics. Looks like prefetch/rehydration amplification triggered eviction cascade.

morgan: root cause hypothesis: prefetcher aggressively rehydrates many large prefixes on miss -> simultaneous writes/evictions on same shard -> thrash and transient connection resets to kv proxies.

eng_lead_tara: next steps: 1) keep bypass until we patch prefetch logic (prevent mass concurrent rehydration) 2) add circuit breaker to kv proxy to shed traffic early 3) plan longer-term: introduce shard-local backpressure and per-prefix queueing.

sre_chris: opened a tracking ticket INF-7832 for the prefetch patch and proxy circuit breaker. Assigning to devon and morgan. ETA for hotfix: 6h for a small change to prefetch concurrency behavior, then canary.

devon: pushing a quick config change to prefetch strategy: prefer randomized jitter + exponential backoff on misses. Will deploy to staging then canary to 10% traffic.

incident-bot: Deploy job started by devon (deploy-1234) -> staging ok.

morgan: canarying config to 10% at 10:42 UTC. Observing for 15m window.

support_julia: updating customers: "We have applied temporary routing mitigations and reduced background prefetch pressure; we expect normal behavior within the hour while we deploy a targeted fix."

devon: canary shows stable 5xx at 0.6% for canary users. rolling to 100% at 11:05 UTC.

anya: metrics look healthy post-rollout: 5xx baseline resumed, evictions normalized. Marking incident as mitigated but keeping monitoring.

eng_lead_tara: thanks team. please add handoff note for next on-call: keep bypass active until INF-7832 is merged and proxy circuit breaker is in place. Also capture sample keys that caused thrash and attach to ticket.

morgan: captured top 50 hot prefixes and attached to INF-7832.

pager: Handoff: devon -> morgan at 11:20 UTC. Current state: mitigation active (routing bypass + prefetch config), 5xx rate normal, monitoring alerts on. Customer impact: limited to some medium-length generation requests, reduced after mitigation.

support_julia: closing customer updates for now, will reopen if regression seen.

sre_chris: postmortem stub created. Will fill with timeline, metrics, and long-term fixes.

eng_lead_tara: good job. :thumbsup:

morgan: locking thread, will reopen if any regression.
